Terms of use

These terms apply to this website, the SSV app and the courses of Shree Siddhivinayak Classes ("SSV", "we"). By using them you agree to these terms.

Your account

You can sign in to the app with your Student ID or email and a password, or with Google. Keep your password private and do not share your account. Tell us straight away if you think someone else is using it. Give accurate details when you register and keep them up to date.

SSV class codes

SSV classroom students receive a class code from SSV. A valid code gives free access to paid courses and notes until the date set by SSV. Codes are for SSV students only and must not be shared. Some courses have their own end date; after it, they must be bought even with a code.

Courses and payments

Free lessons are open to every registered student. Paid courses and notes unlock after a successful payment. Prices are shown in the app before you pay. Payments are handled by Razorpay, and you agree to pay all charges made with the payment method you use.

How you may use the content

You get a personal, non-commercial licence to watch and read course material in the app. It is a licence, not a transfer of ownership. You may not:

  • Copy, record, download (other than through the app's own download button), share or resell videos or notes
  • Share your account or class code
  • Try to get around how access is controlled

Intellectual property

All course material, including videos, PDFs, text, graphics and the SSV name and logo, belongs to Shree Siddhivinayak Classes and is protected by copyright law.

Study assistant

The study assistant gives automatic explanations. Answers can be wrong. Check important points with your teacher.

Refunds and delivery

Cancellations and refunds follow our refund policy. How courses and material reach you is set out in our delivery policy.

Changes to the service

We may add, change or remove courses and features, and update these terms. When we update them, we will change the date above.

Limitation of liability

To the extent the law allows, SSV is not liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages from using, or being unable to use, the website, the app or the courses.

Contact

Email contact@siddhivinayakclasses.org. We reply on working days.
